Chinese stock option implied volatility increases as shares sell off
iShares FTSE Xinhua China 25 Index ( FXI ) June weekly call option implied volatility is at 28, July is at 22; compared to its 52-week range of 14 to 33. Call put ratio 1 call to 1.42 puts as shares sell off 2.2%.
Alibaba ( NYSE: BABA ) June weekly call option implied volatility is at 43, July is at 34; compared to its 52-week range of 24 to 43. Call put ratio 1.7 calls to 1 put as shares sell off 5%.
China Mobile ( CHL ) July call option implied volatility is at 16, August is at 17; compared to its 52-week range of 12 to 25. Option implied volatility bid as shares near four-year low.
Sinopec ( SNP ) July and August call option implied volatility is at 29; compared to its 52-week range of 16 to 36 as shares sell off 3.7%.
China Life Insurance ( LFC ) July and August call option implied volatility is at 22; compared to its 52-week range of 12 to 36 as shares trade at 18-month low.
Baidu ( BIDU ) June weekly call option implied volatility is at 48, July is at 33; compared to its 52-week range of 24 to 50. Call put ratio 2.3 calls to 1 put on active June weekly 255 calls as shares sell off 3.4%.
Weibo ( WB ) July call option implied volatility is at 47, August is at 51; compared to its 52-week range of 39 to 70. Call put ratio 1.38 calls to 1 put as shares sell off 4.5%.
SINA Corp ( SINA ) June weekly call option implied volatility is at 38, July is at 42; compared to its 52-week range of 32 to 62. Call put ratio 1.5 calls to 1 put as shares sell off 3%.
iQIYI ( IQ ) June weekly call option implied volatility is at 125, July is at 107; compared to its 52-week range of 57 to 121. Call put ratio 1.8 calls to 1 put as shares sell off 7%.
